<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/storage-management">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Reorder" name="Product reorder"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DeliveryDelayPenalty" name="Delivery delay penalty demand"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProductArrival" name="Product arrival"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CourierRequest" name="Courier request"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_StorageManagement">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" processRef="Process_StorageManagement"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Wholesaler" name="Wholesaler"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Courier" name="Courier"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Reorder" name="Reorder product" sourceRef="Task_ReorderProduct" targetRef="Participant_Wholesaler" messageRef="Message_Reorder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Penalty" name="Demand delivery delay penalty" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="Participant_Wholesaler" messageRef="Message_DeliveryDelayPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProductArrival" name="Product arrival" sourceRef="Participant_Wholesaler" targetRef="Event_ProductArrived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProductArrivalAfterDelay" name="Product arrival" sourceRef="Participant_Wholesaler" targetRef="Event_ProductArrivedAfterDelay"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CourierRequest" name="Request courier" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Participant_Courier" messageRef="Message_CourierRequest"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Process" name="Start"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReadOrder" name="Read order from order management system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check whether selected product is in stock"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockDecision" name="Selected product in stock?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WithdrawProduct" name="Withdraw product from warehouse"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderProduct" name="Reorder product from wholesaler" messageRef="Message_Reorder"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_ArrivalOrTimeout" name="Wait for arrival or 10 days to elapse" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ProductArrived" name="Product arrives within 10 days">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ProductArrived" messageRef="Message_ProductArrival"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_10DaysElapsed" name="10 days elapse without product arrival">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_10Days">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P10D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DemandPenalty" name="Automatically demand delivery delay penalty" messageRef="Message_DeliveryDelayPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ProductArrivedAfterDelay" name="Product arrives after delay">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ProductArrivedAfterDelay" messageRef="Message_ProductArrival"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterProduct" name="Register product in stock management system"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockMerge" name="Continue after product handling" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderReady" name="Whole order ready for shipment?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectNextProduct" name="Select next product from order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShipmentSplit" name="Arrange shipment work" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestCourier" name="Request courier" messageRef="Message_CourierRequest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackProducts" name="Pack products"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShipmentJoin" name="Courier requested and products packed" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShipProducts" name="Ship products"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Shipped" name="Order shipped"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Read" sourceRef="StartEvent_Process" targetRef="Task_ReadOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Read_CheckStock" sourceRef="Task_ReadOrder" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckStock_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_StockDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockYes" name="In stock" sourceRef="Gateway_StockDecision" targetRef="Task_WithdrawProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">selected product is in stock</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockNo" name="Not in stock" sourceRef="Gateway_StockDecision" targetRef="Task_ReorderProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Withdraw_Merge" sourceRef="Task_WithdrawProduct" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reorder_Wait" sourceRef="Task_ReorderProduct" targetRef="Gateway_ArrivalOrTimeout"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Arrival" sourceRef="Gateway_ArrivalOrTimeout" targetRef="Event_ProductArrived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Timeout" sourceRef="Gateway_ArrivalOrTimeout" targetRef="Event_10DaysElapsed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Arrival_Register" sourceRef="Event_ProductArrived" targetRef="Task_RegisterProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Timeout_Penalty" sourceRef="Event_10DaysElapsed" targetRef="Task_DemandPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Penalty_WaitArrival" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="Event_ProductArrivedAfterDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ArrivalAfterDelay_Register" sourceRef="Event_ProductArrivedAfterDelay" targetRef="Task_RegisterProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Register_Merge" sourceRef="Task_RegisterProduct" targetRef="Gateway_StockMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_OrderReady" sourceRef="Gateway_StockMerge" targetRef="Gateway_OrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderReady_Yes" name="Ready" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReady" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">whole order is ready for shipment</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderReady_No" name="Not ready" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReady" targetRef="Task_SelectNextProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NextProduct_CheckStock" sourceRef="Task_SelectNextProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_RequestCourier" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentSplit" targetRef="Task_RequestCourier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_PackProducts" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentSplit" targetRef="Task_PackProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestCourier_Join" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackProducts_Join" sourceRef="Task_PackProducts" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Ship" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin" targetRef="Task_ShipProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ship_End" sourceRef="Task_ShipProducts" targetRef="EndEvent_Shipped"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/storage-management">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProductReorder" name="Product reorder"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProductArrival" name="Product arrival"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DeliveryDelayPenalty" name="Delivery delay penalty demand"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CourierRequest" name="Courier request"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_StorageManagement">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" processRef="Process_StorageManagement"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Wholesaler" name="Wholesaler"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Courier" name="Courier"/>

                      sourceRef="Task_ReorderProduct" targetRef="Participant_Wholesaler"
                      messageRef="Message_ProductReorder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProductArrival" name="Product arrival"
                      sourceRef="Participant_Wholesaler" targetRef="Event_ProductArrived"
                      messageRef="Message_ProductArrival"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DeliveryDelayPenalty" name="Demand delivery delay penalty"
                      sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="Participant_Wholesaler"
                      messageRef="Message_DeliveryDelayPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CourierRequest" name="Request courier"
                      sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Participant_Courier"
                      messageRef="Message_CourierRequest"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Process"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReadOrder" name="Read order from automatic order management system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check whether the current product is in stock"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StockDecision" name="Current product in stock?"
                           default="Flow_StockNo"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WithdrawProduct" name="Withdraw product from warehouse"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderProduct" name="Reorder product from wholesaler"
                   messageRef="Message_ProductReorder"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ProductArrived" name="Product arrives">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ProductArrived"
                                   messageRef="Message_ProductArrival"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckWaitDuration" name="Check whether arrival took more than 10 days"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DelayDecision" name="Waited more than 10 days?"
                           default="Flow_NoDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DemandPenalty" name="Automatically demand delivery delay penalty"
                   messageRef="Message_DeliveryDelayPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DelayMerge" name="Continue after delay check"
                           gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterProduct" name="Register product in stock management system"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ProductMerge" name="Continue after product handling"
                           gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckOrderReady" name="Check whether the whole order is ready for shipment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderReady" name="Whole order ready for shipment?"
                           default="Flow_OrderNotReady"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectNextProduct" name="Select next product from the order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShipmentSplit" name="Arrange shipment work"
                          gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestCourier" name="Request courier"
                   messageRef="Message_CourierRequest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackProducts" name="Pack products"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShipmentJoin" name="Courier requested and products packed"
                          gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShipProducts" name="Ship products"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckStock_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_StockDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockYes" name="In stock" sourceRef="Gateway_StockDecision" targetRef="Task_WithdrawProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">currentProductIsInStock</bpmn:conditionExpression>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reorder_Arrival" sourceRef="Task_ReorderProduct" targetRef="Event_ProductArrived"/>

      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">waitingTimeDays > 10</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoDelay" name="10 days or less" sourceRef="Gateway_DelayDecision" targetRef="Gateway_DelayMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Penalty_DelayMerge" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="Gateway_DelayMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DelayMerge_Register" sourceRef="Gateway_DelayMerge" targetRef="Task_RegisterProduct"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProductMerge_CheckReady" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckOrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckReady_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckOrderReady" targetRef="Gateway_OrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderReady_Yes" name="Ready" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReady" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">wholeOrderIsReadyForShipment</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderNotReady" name="Not ready" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReady" targetRef="Task_SelectNextProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NextProduct_CheckStock" sourceRef="Task_SelectNextProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_RequestCourier" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentSplit" targetRef="Task_RequestCourier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_PackProducts" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentSplit" targetRef="Task_PackProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestCourier_Join" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackProducts_Join" sourceRef="Task_PackProducts" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Ship" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin" targetRef="Task_ShipProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ship_End" sourceRef="Task_ShipProducts" targetRef="EndEvent_Shipped"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderReady" name="Whole order ready for shipment?" default="Flow_OrderNotReady"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectNextProduct" name="Select next product from order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShipmentSplit" name="Arrange shipment work" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestCourier" name="Request courier" messageRef="Message_CourierRequest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackProducts" name="Pack products"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShipmentJoin" name="Courier requested and products packed" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShipProducts" name="Ship products"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Shipped" name="Order shipped"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Read" sourceRef="StartEvent_Process" targetRef="Task_ReadOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Read_CheckStock" sourceRef="Task_ReadOrder" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckStock_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_StockDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockYes" name="In stock" sourceRef="Gateway_StockDecision" targetRef="Task_WithdrawProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">first product is in stock</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StockNo" name="Not in stock" sourceRef="Gateway_StockDecision" targetRef="Task_ReorderProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Withdraw_ProductMerge" sourceRef="Task_WithdrawProduct" targetRef="Gateway_ProductMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reorder_Arrival" sourceRef="Task_ReorderProduct" targetRef="Event_ProductArrived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Arrival_DelayDecision" sourceRef="Event_ProductArrived" targetRef="Gateway_DelayDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DelayYes" name="More than 10 days" sourceRef="Gateway_DelayDecision" targetRef="Task_DemandPenalty">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">waiting time is greater than 10 days</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoDelay" name="10 days or less" sourceRef="Gateway_DelayDecision" targetRef="Gateway_DelayMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Penalty_DelayMerge" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="Gateway_DelayMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DelayMerge_Register" sourceRef="Gateway_DelayMerge" targetRef="Task_RegisterProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Register_ProductMerge" sourceRef="Task_RegisterProduct" targetRef="Gateway_ProductMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ProductMerge_CheckOrderReady" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductMerge" targetRef="Task_CheckOrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckOrderReady_Decision" sourceRef="Task_CheckOrderReady" targetRef="Gateway_OrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderReady_Yes" name="Ready" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReady" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">whole order is ready for shipment</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderNotReady" name="Not ready" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReady" targetRef="Task_SelectNextProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NextProduct_CheckStock" sourceRef="Task_SelectNextProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_RequestCourier" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentSplit" targetRef="Task_RequestCourier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_PackProducts" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentSplit" targetRef="Task_PackProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestCourier_Join" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackProducts_Join" sourceRef="Task_PackProducts" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Ship" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin" targetRef="Task_ShipProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ship_End" sourceRef="Task_ShipProducts" targetRef="EndEvent_Shipped"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
